scope: Pure offline aggregate and preregistered-method review; no product mutation or paid execution.

pairs.native: arm or null if not observed
pairs.loom: arm or null if not observed

arm.roundsCompleted: 0..12 business rounds actually completed, not CLI spawns

usage.requests: same; count attempts under frozen request definition, not usage chunks
usage.cachedInput: same; unknown partial subtotal remains known but complete=false
usage.reasoningOutput: same optional; absence yields unknown, never zero-complete

quality.passed: completed rounds passing original frozen verdict
quality.failed: completed rounds failing original frozen verdict
quality.unknown: completed rounds without established verdict; counts sum to roundsCompleted

rules: Main fixedN ratios unavailable unless six terminal completed pairs each have both12-round sessions. Within that group each dimension separately requires complete request census and dimension coverage.
Complete12 subset is descriptive only when planned six are not all completed; count and IDs exposed, potential stopping selection bias explicit.
All observed and outside-complete12 totals retain failed/truncated/unpaired known costs; no efficiency ratios for these imbalanced groups.
Qualityfalse remains in costs; compare quality independently. No selecting successful pairs or good rounds.
Complete ratios are sum Loom / sum native, not mean of ratios. Pair ratio vector and min/max labelled observed ranges.
Uncached available only when input and cached both complete; missing optional does not erase complete input/output. Reasoning is an output subset, never added.
Unknown/zero denominator yields null, not zero/infinity; arithmetic safe-integer overflow rejects.
Duplicate/unplanned identifiers and mixed CLI/model/effort reject. Missing planned pairs explicitly not-started.

bootstrap.unit: One entire paired set of continuous sessions, same sampled indices for native and Loom
bootstrap.enumeration: All ordered six-index sequences from six pairs with replacement, 6^6; no random seed noise
bootstrap.interval: Exploratory 2.5th/97.5th percentiles with linear interpolation, only all six completed and that dimension fully covered. Any possible zero-denominator resampling prevents interval.
bootstrap.limits: n=6 empirical percentile interval is not stability, population coverage or independence proof. Same account/cache/time ordering can still create dependencies. Rounds/requests are not replicates.

admissionMethodReview.ordering: Frozen balanced order mitigates order confounding; it does not eliminate shared provider cache, load or time drift. Keep session cache keys native; do not purge/change cache to manufacture independence.
admissionMethodReview.budget: Pi18M/300k/400 and Kimi10M/120k/300 perpair exceed observed earlier completed pairs, but prior n=2 cannot guarantee completion. Caps are prelaunch soft thresholds, not hard bill ceilings; in-flight overrun remains possible.
admissionMethodReview.fixedN: No optional stopping after favorable ratios, no replacement failed pair, no increased caps mid-run. Missing slots remain visible after stop.
admissionMethodReview.fatalGates: Unknown primary/capture, model/config/source/cleanup errors stop this CLI; other CLI may continue. Pure budget policy must be explicitly frozen before paid; Pi/Kimi currently differ and root notified.
admissionMethodReview.endpoint: Actual paid path remains current original native-final product configuration; private compact standing candidate excluded.
